job.job_description:
Skills & Tools

Hands-on agentic AI / LLM engineering: building and operating MCP servers, agent workflows, prompt design, and output validation.

REST API integration: Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Tableau Server, SSRS, Azure DevOps, Azure Resource Manager.

Code analysis tooling: SQL parsing, PySpark/DAX comparison, NLP-based semantic similarity, dependency graph construction.

Strong SQL and Python; Git repository automation.

Experience: 5+ years data engineering or platform automation; 12+ years hands-on LLM/agentic systems (MCP, agent frameworks) in production or client-delivery settings.

Own all AI-accelerated and MCP-driven discovery and analysis across the assessment automating repeatable scanning, extraction, and cross-referencing work so senior experts can focus on judgment and client-facing output.

Build and run automated extraction and classification of database schemas and stored procedures across a multi-database SQL Server estate (MCP + SQL introspection agents).

Run SSIS package inventory scans and map packages to their Fabric pipeline replacements (MCP + Azure DevOps API); scan pipeline code for parameterization, hardcoding, and naming-convention compliance (Git repository analysis).

Run lakehouse table inventory and completeness scans via OneLake metadata (Fabric REST API); scan Delta tables for OPTIMIZE/VACUUM/Z-ORDER compliance; detect presence or absence of data quality checks in transformation code.

Map stored procedures to PySpark equivalents via automated code comparison and semantic similarity analysis (AI code analysis + NLP); detect cross-layer business logic duplication via graph mapping; run automated KPI definition comparison across DAX, PySpark, and SQL stored procedures for priority business metrics.

Extract report inventories and dependencies from legacy BI platforms (Tableau Server REST API, SSRS REST API); inventory semantic models and extract DAX measures (Power BI REST API); detect hidden legacy-database dependencies in Power BI reports via AI dependency graph analysis.

Run lineage gap assessment across pipeline notebook table report dependency graphs (Fabric Lineage API); scan access-control configuration across Fabric, Databricks, and Azure (Azure Resource Manager API); automate evidence aggregation and weekly finding summaries for expert review.
